title: The Entangled Veil: Why Redistribution Requires a New Language
abstract: arXiv:2611.30045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Rawlsian veil of ignorance requires choosing principles of justice without knowing which position-temporal, spatial, social, or personal one will occupy. We argue that this object cannot be represented faithfully within standard economic models. A faithful representation must satisfy three requirements: it must treat all generations symmetrically, capture non-separable correlations among positions, and allow mobility costs to vary across locations and occupations. We show that standard optimal-tax models violate at least one requirement, and that the minimal framework satisfying all three is a geometric framework adapted from string theory, in which the veil is an entangled state over a space of possible life situations. translated_title: 纠缠之幕：为什么再分配需要一种新的语言
translated_abstract: 罗尔斯的无知之幕要求人们在不知道自己将占据何种位置——时间上的、空间上的、社会上的或个人上的——的情况下选择正义原则。我们论证，这一对象无法在标准经济模型中得到忠实的表示。忠实的表示必须满足三个要求：它必须对称地对待所有世代，捕捉各位置之间不可分离的关联性，并允许流动性成本在不同地点和职业之间有所变化。我们证明标准的最优税收模型至少违反其中一项要求，而同时满足这三项要求的最小框架是一个改编自弦理论的几何框架，在该框架中，无知之幕被表示为可能生活情境空间上的一个纠缠态。我们由此推导出完全平等化作为第一最优基准、当关联性奖励差异性时分离集群的出现、代际内部公平与代际间公平之间的对称性，以及一个隧穿机制……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文论证罗尔斯的“无知之幕”无法在标准经济模型中被忠实表示，并提出一个改编自弦理论的最小几何框架，将无知之幕刻画为可能生活情境空间上的纠缠态，从而为再分配与正义理论提供了一种新的数学语言。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the Rawlsian veil of ignorance cannot be faithfully represented within standard economic models, and proposes a minimal geometric framework adapted from string theory—in which the veil is an entangled state over a space of possible life situations—as a new mathematical language for redistribution theory.
